slice: Unweighted metric LiDAR/IMU startup alignment; exact gyro-bias reintegration, fixed caller acceleration bias, gravity/velocities from displacement equations.
inputs: Increasing integer reference timestamps, proper metric LiDAR poses, full IMU-from-LiDAR transform, initial gyro bias, fixed SI acceleration bias and explicit physical acceptance limits.
model: Same left-held measurements/scale as existing preintegration. Remove initial map origin before lever-arm and displacement arithmetic. No reported orientation use and no stationary-start assumption.
gyro: Gauss-Newton in three gyro-bias coordinates, existing analytical SO(3)/preintegration derivatives; exact reintegration at each accepted bias. Deterministic indexed parallel edge integration optional; scalar ordered normal-equation accumulation.
linear: Eliminate velocities with adjacent displacement triples. Fit one world gravity vector; derive each reference velocity. Acceleration bias is fixed and declared because it cannot be separated from gravity without additional observability/model constraints.
acceptance: Proper frame/time/sensor/gap/finite checks; gyro sensitivity rank, bounded bias correction, gravity magnitude agreement, rotation RMS norm and velocity-equation RMS norm. No hidden regularization, gravity normalization or fallback state.

real_prefix.selection: First 64 fully covered source scans. Pose time is max per-point integer timestamp. Pure LiDAR ICP, deskew=False, no IMU prediction.

oracle: Independent standard ROS decoding, SciPy held-gyro integration and finite-difference least-squares bias fit, NumPy gravity/velocity equations. Report rejection without relaxing the frozen acceptance limits.
scope: Startup consistency and numerical/contract validation. No reference-pose parsing, calibration ground truth, physical trajectory accuracy, runtime or GPU claim.
